intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Jaipuria Noida vs IMS Noida is not a single winner. Jaipuria Noida has a recorded NIRF 2025 #41, and IMS Noida has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: Jaipuria Noida vs IMS Noida for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Jaipuria Noida if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #41, and a 2023 flagship package record of ₹11 LPA, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Noida.
Choose IMS Noida if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹9 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹2 lakh, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Noida.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹14.5 lakh as a programme total for PGDM (Marketing) at Jaipuria Noida.
Our records show ₹2 lakh as a tuition figure for MBA at IMS Noida. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Jaipuria Noida's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹11 LPA and a highest package of ₹22 LPA on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

IMS Noida's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹9 LPA and a highest package of ₹27 LPA on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Jaipuria Noida is listed on our records with ATMA, CAT, XAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
IMS Noida is listed on our records with CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Uttar Pradesh. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Jaipuria Noida's recorded ₹14.5 lakh or IMS Noida's ₹2 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Jaipuria Noida or IMS Noida?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Jaipuria Noida and IMS Noida differ in more than one way: Jaipuria Noida has a recorded NIRF 2025 #41, and IMS Noida has no NIRF rank on this page.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Jaipuria Noida vs IMS Noida?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹14.5 lakh for Jaipuria Noida on PGDM (Marketing); our records list ₹2 lakh for IMS Noida on MBA. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Jaipuria Noida and IMS Noida?
faqs.answer: Jaipuria Noida's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹11 LPA and a highest package of ₹22 LPA on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Jaipuria Noida and IMS Noida accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list ATMA, CAT, XAT for Jaipuria Noida, and CAT for IMS Noida. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Jaipuria Noida and IMS Noida in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
